AI can't see the word "strawberry." Seriously.
Welcome to Agent School — lesson three.
Today: what those examples actually look like to the machine.
It reads tokens — chunks of text.
So the model sees a short list of numbers — not ten letters.
That's why some models famously miscounted the R's in strawberry.
In English, one token is roughly three quarters of a word.
About a hundred and thirty tokens.
And tokens matter for you, because AI is priced in tokens, and its memory is measured in tokens.
